sources.title: University of Antwerp METOX phospholipid LC-ESI-QTOF MS2 records
sources.authors_or_organization: da Silva KM; Iturrospe E; van de Lavoir M; Robeyns R; University of Antwerp
sources.release: API records fetched 2026-08-26; individual record dates and hashes preserved
sources.access_level: full experimental record and peak list
supported_claims: Observed product-ion and neutral-loss occurrence in the named records
Agilent 6560 QTOF, CID, reported 10/20/40 eV, positive [M+H]+ conditions
limitations: One laboratory and one instrument model
Repository collision-energy labels are preserved as reported and are not physical cross-platform calibration
Class evidence cannot confirm exact identity or distinguish isomers

sources.title: MassBank Record Format, version 2.6.0
supported_claims: Instrument model, fragmentation mode, collision energy, collision gas, and peak lists are separate record fields
limitations: Optional fields can be missing
The format does not make unlike collision-energy units interchangeable

sources.title: Electrospray ionization/tandem quadrupole mass spectrometric studies on phosphatidylcholines: the fragmentation processes
supported_claims: Low-energy CAD fragmentation pathways of phosphatidylcholine ions
limitations: Tandem-quadrupole conditions do not establish Agilent 6560 CE equivalence
Phosphocholine fragments are not unique to phosphatidylcholine

sources.title: Charge-remote and charge-driven fragmentation processes in diacyl glycerophosphoethanolamine upon low-energy collisional activation: a mechanistic proposal
supported_claims: Low-energy CAD fragmentation pathways of diacyl glycerophosphoethanolamines
limitations: Mechanistic observations do not supply an Agilent 6560 CE conversion
Headgroup loss does not determine acyl positions or stereochemistry

sources.title: Identification of ethanolamine plasmalogens from complex lipid mixtures by MS/MS and Ag adduction
sources.authors_or_organization: Kim SJ; Kim N; Koh EH; Yoo HJ
supported_claims: Neutral loss 141 can be weak for ethanolamine plasmalogens in positive-ion CID
limitations: Ag-adduct enhancement is outside the [M+H]+ rules in this catalog

sources.title: Tandem Mass Spectrometry across Platforms
sources.locator: Anal Chem 96:5478-5488; Methods and cross-platform results
supported_claims: Agilent, Bruker, SCIEX, Waters QTOF and Thermo Q Exactive spectra differ with platform and CE
In the studied standards, nominal 20 eV produced more cross-platform matches than 10 or 40 eV
limitations: The observed 20 eV result is dataset-specific, not a universal CE conversion
High cosine similarity did not prevent an isomeric lipid misidentification

sources.title: Q Exactive HF-X Software Manual, Exactive Series 2.9
sources.locator: HCD collision energy, normalized collision energy, stepped CE sections
supported_claims: Q Exactive HCD accepts absolute CE in eV or dimensionless NCE
NCE only approximates eV for the reference m/z 500, z=1 ion and actual energy depends on precursor mass and charge
Stepped energies produce one composite detected spectrum
limitations: Peptide-derived charge adjustments cannot be applied to all small molecules
No universal NCE-to-QTOF conversion is supplied

sources.title: Higher-energy C-trap dissociation for peptide modification analysis
supported_claims: HCD uses an additional multipole collision cell and yields high-resolution full-range MS/MS
limitations: Peptide results do not establish small-molecule CE transfer

sources.title: 6200 Series TOF and 6500 Series Q-TOF LC/MS System Concepts Guide
sources.locator: Collision cell and collision energy sections; All-Ions examples
supported_claims: 6500 QTOF uses a nitrogen-filled axially accelerating hexapole collision cell
Methods can use fixed CE, m/z-dependent slope/offset, or CE tables
limitations: The guide uses voltage labels in some methods and does not authorize cross-vendor equivalence
Collision-cell settings vary by model

sources.title: MassHunter PCDL Familiarization Guide
sources.locator: Auto-MS/MS collision-energy slope and offset example
supported_claims: The example method calculates CE from precursor m/z using a slope and offset
limitations: The example coefficients are method settings, not universal constants

sources.title: TripleTOF 6600 System User Guide
sources.locator: Q2 collision cell; CE and CES parameters
supported_claims: CE controls the potential difference into the nitrogen-filled Q2 collision cell
CES can combine CE-CES, CE, and CE+CES product-ion energies
limitations: A CES composite cannot be represented as one fixed energy
CAD gas pressure remains a separate condition

sources.title: Optimized rolling collision energy curves for IDA and SWATH DIA for peptides
sources.locator: Rolling CE and CES acquisition descriptions
supported_claims: Rolling CE depends on precursor m/z and charge; CES semantics depend on acquisition mode
limitations: The reported curves were trained on tryptic peptides and cannot be transferred to small molecules without testing

sources.title: The Art of Destruction: Optimizing Collision Energies in Q-TOF MS of Glycopeptides
sources.locator: Bruker impact II, 10-140 eV energy-resolved experiments
supported_claims: Optimal Bruker impact II collision energy depended on precursor m/z and fragmentation channel
limitations: Glycopeptide results are not a universal small-molecule calibration

sources.title: LCMS-180: COVID impact II application note
sources.locator: impact II MS/MS and bbCID acquisition methods
supported_claims: impact II methods can use fixed or ranged collision energies; bbCID alternates full-scan and broadband fragmentation
limitations: bbCID is not precursor-selected fixed-CE MS/MS

sources.title: SYNAPT G2-S Overview and Maintenance Guide
sources.locator: Triwave trap and transfer collision-cell descriptions
supported_claims: SYNAPT has distinct Trap and Transfer T-Wave regions that can fragment ions
limitations: A record labeled only Waters QTOF CID does not identify the collision region

sources.title: MassLynx NT Guide to Data Acquisition
supported_claims: MassLynx collision-energy ramps use mass points and start/end voltages
limitations: A ramp midpoint is not a fixed-energy observation

sources.title: The Simultaneous Acquisition of Exact Mass Data Using Alternating Collision Cell Energy MSE
sources.authors_or_organization: Waters Corporation; Rainville P; Plumb R
supported_claims: MSE alternates low- and high-energy functions
limitations: MSE high-energy spectra are not precursor-selected fixed-CE spectra

sources.title: Collision energies on QTof and Orbitrap instruments: How to make proteomics measurements comparable?
sources.locator: Bruker Maxis II CID versus Q Exactive Focus HCD experiments
supported_claims: Matched peptide spectra required empirical CE adjustment between the studied QTOF and Orbitrap
limitations: The peptide comparison does not provide a universal metabolite or NCE conversion

sources.title: V15 feature-fragment mass-window and evidence policy
supported_claims: Rule-specific max(abs Da, ppm) windows and Jeffreys-smoothed conditional likelihood ratios are engineering choices
Correlated rules contribute at most one likelihood-ratio term per declared independent fragmentation group
limitations: Engineering settings do not establish chemical specificity
Performance claims require identity- and formula-family-isolated public spectra
